description: List all leaderboards (boards) under a given game. Each board has its own id, slug, ranking (sortDir: desc = high-score-wins, asc = lowest-time-wins), score kind (integer / duration_ms / float), retention policy, and optional min/max score bounds. Call this to find a board's id before generating a snippet (get_sdk_snippet) or reading standings (get_board_top_n), or to show the developer what boards already exist under a game returned by list_games.

gameId.description: UUID of the game to list boards for (from list_games)

name: list_boards
